parts.note_add: Catalogue figure 1820A-1 (S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.57, printed 1-15) shows D-code 24496 as the small spring-loaded centre contact (carbon button) that sits in the centre of the distributor cap (24310) and bears on the rotor (24312); it is not a breaker point - the distributor is breakerless. 1985 FSM p.5-33 says to check the cap's centre contact for wear; no wear limit is given. Identification read from the drawing; confirm on the car.

specs.item: Part identity: centre contact (carbon button with spring) inside the distributor cap, bearing on the rotor
specs.note: Read from the exploded drawing: 24496 is drawn between cap 24310 and rotor 24312. Qty 1. confirm on the car.

specs.item: Inspection: check the distributor cap centre contact for wear (replace if necessary); no numeric wear limit given
specs.page: Section 5 p.5-33 (PDF p.33), Distributor - Inspection - Distributor cap
specs.note: 1985 12A breakerless distributor; no 1982 source opened gives an inspection figure.
